steps: Dice the onion finely and mince the garlic cloves.
Cut the chicken into small 1 cm cubes, suitable for toddlers.
Cook the rice pasta in a large pot of boiling water for 8 minutes, until tender; drain and set aside.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the onion and garlic; cook for 3 minutes, stirring, until the onion is soft.
Add the chicken cubes; cook for 5 to 6 minutes, until no pink remains.
Pour in the crushed tomatoes and vegetable broth; stir in the dried basil and salt.
Add the green peas; simmer for 4 to 5 minutes, until the peas are tender and the sauce thickens.
Fold in the drained rice pasta; stir gently for 1 minute over low heat to combine.
Serve warm. Makes 4 family portions. Refrigerate leftovers for up to 2 days or freeze for up to 1 month.
